raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Trace the structure from left to right and list only non-H bond connections: O-C, C-R, C-N, C-C to the upper-left ring carbon, C-C across the top of the ring, the C=C connection on the right side of the ring counted as one bond connection, C-R1, N-C on the right side, and N-R2. Exclude O-H and C-H, and disregard the curved arrows. The enumerated non-H bond connections total 9.

method.method_draft: Partition the drawing into two parts. First count the non-H connections forming the cyclic/backbone framework: left carbon to upper-left carbon, upper-left carbon to upper-right carbon, upper-right carbon to lower-right carbon as the displayed double-bond connection, lower-right carbon to N, and N to left carbon = 5 framework connections. Then count non-H substituent connections: left carbon-O, left carbon-R, lower-right carbon-R1, and N-R2 = 4 more. Exclude O-H and the C-H at the top because they involve hydrogen; ignore curved arrows. Sum 5 + 4 = 9.
